samples.question: One motion of the plane carries the green tile exactly onto the orange tile; call it A. One motion carries the blue tile exactly onto the cyan tile; call it B. Each of them may be a turn, a slide or a flip. Apply A to the purple dot, then apply B to where it lands. Which black square does the dot end in? The four black squares are numbered 1 to 4 from left to right. Answer with exactly one of: square-1, square-2, square-3, square-4.
